# DBZ LSW ROM Research V4 FX

Physical reverse engineering of the card FX pipeline using the canonical USA ROM.

Start with `REPORT.md`, then `AGENT_HANDOFF_V4.md`.

`generated_fx_assets/` is a review/export of ROM BG-tilemap windows. Color index 0 is made transparent in those PNGs for inspection only; this alpha is not canonical GBC behavior.
